purpose: Small source-attributed published-excerpt diagnostic; no tuning, population accuracy or private-user evidence.
quote_scope: At most25 whitespace-delimited quoted snippet words per unique source URL across all records. Excerpts are contiguous and contain no URLs. Titles/attribution are metadata.
selection_limit: Only opened primary-page text verified. PDF illustrative screenshot snippets were excluded because web screenshot calls returned no inspectable pixels; no search-only excerpt admitted. Failed task-scam page fetch excluded.
